name: Scott Gaspard
bio:
I've been selling real estate in south Louisiana since 1998. In 2026, we opened Gaspard & Co Real Estate to bring some of the area's most experienced agents under one roof.

My approach is simple: price it right, market it well, and keep you informed at every step. I study the market closely so my clients can make decisions with confidence, whether they're selling a longtime family home or buying their first. My wife Jessica and I have 13 kids, so I know what a move means for a household, and I'll treat you like family from start to finish. Our clients have given us more than 350 five-star reviews on Zillow and Google, and earning that trust is still what I work for every day.
